articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Crypto exchanges shouldn’t double as the vault
articles.snippet: A single breach moved billions out of Binance in minutes, exposing how much client money sits with the venue that trades it. Darren Jordan of Komainu argues institutions should keep trading and custody separate, as traditional markets have for decades, and sets out the questions to ask about where assets are held.

articles.title: Hong Kong wants banks to use AI to catch crypto crime before money disappears
articles.snippet: As Hong Kong pushes banks to use AI to combat crypto crime, experts say the technology must detect suspicious transfers without putting customer funds at risk.

articles.title: Bitcoin's 12% slide through key support looks scary, but history says give it 3 months
articles.snippet: Bitcoin broke below its 200-week average with a 12% drop. Only three similar crashes have occurred since 2013. Here’s what happened next.

articles.title: Hong Kong, Swift test tokenized deposits as banks chase stablecoin-style speed
articles.snippet: Hong Kong and Swift expanded their efforts to connect tokenized bank deposits across currencies, building on earlier work involving digital central bank money.

articles.snippet: Bitcoin price downside sees local lows of $63,269 as Nvidia stock targets $150 as traders brace for volatility over Q3 earnings.
